messages:
oliver.sales: FYI POC with Sentinel Bank — they see many log batches with no trace_id in the console and intermittent 403s from their forwarder, then 429s from our ingest. Customer worried about missing telemetry.
mari.ops: Can you drop the exact forwarder error lines and a sample event?
oliver.sales: pasted below:
```
2026-11-05T11:03:12Z INFO batch=5 size=1.8MB uploading
2026-11-05T11:03:13Z ERROR upload failed status=403 err="AccessDenied: PutObject" attempt=0
2026-11-05T11:03:13Z INFO assumed role arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/sentinel-forwarder session=3600
2026-11-05T11:03:15Z INFO retrying upload attempt=1
2026-11-05T11:03:18Z ERROR upload failed status=429 err="TooManyRequests" attempt=1
```
mari.ops: This pattern matches mid-batch STS credential rotation + ingest throttle. Partial metadata gets written, bodies get retried/failed -> downstream joiner loses trace_id for that batch.
cheng.eng: Short actionable options: 1) Increase the STS sessionDuration on their role to >1h so the forwarder doesn't refresh mid-batch. 2) Enable forwarder local buffering/atomic uploads so batches commit only when fully uploaded. 3) Temp bump ingest burst for the org during the POC to avoid 429s.
oliver.sales: Which of those can they do themselves quickly? Customer asked for a one-line they can give their SRE.
mari.ops: One-liner: "Increase STS sessionDuration and allow s3:PutObject on the forwarder prefix; as a quick workaround enable local buffering in the forwarder."
cheng.eng: Config snippet to paste into their forwarder YAML:
```
forwarder:
  buffer_mode: local
  fallback_local_buffering: true
  s3_prefix: "sentinel/poc/%{env}/"
  aws_sts_session_duration: 14400
  retry:
    max_attempts: 4
```
mari.ops: If they can't touch AWS role settings, we can route uploads through our KMS-backed upload-proxy (requires ent approval) which avoids role-refresh issues but has higher latency.
support-bot: [quota] Temporary ingest burst granted org=sentinel-889 ttl=2h by cheng.eng :white_check_mark:
oliver.sales: I'll send the snippet + one-liner and ask them to flip buffer_mode. Please confirm no duplicates after buffering.
mari.ops: Will run a duplicate scan in ~25m and report back.
support-bot: [reminder] ingest burst for sentinel-889 expires in 1h 50m — will post 15m before expiry.
oliver.sales: Thanks all, I'll close the loop with Sentinel Bank and add this to the POC checklist KB. :thumbsup:
